triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

**Released and graded** (23:0xZ): the maintainer released it from the #34659 hold (「可以放行」, recorded on #34659 at 22:58Z, comment 6963486364). `pm:on-hold` → `pm:queue`, **p1 · domain:server**.

Theme: MCP, the core door of epic #34659 (in focus). External agents get list, read, save and discard of metadata drafts, each save answered with the publish verdict, so an agent can build without publishing blind. It gates #34774, #34778 and #34780. So p1.

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzfR33NbV51QQU6R6bm

Claim: PM loop (area o3-E, epic #34659, PR-a of the seat-approved split) · 2026-11-17T23:12Z
Session: `session_01WGufzfR33NbV51QQU6R6bm`
Account: `os-support-ai`
Branch: `claude/issue-34766-mcp-draft-door-read`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-34766`
Domain: `domain:server`
Seat: `repo:objectstack#3`
File surface: PR-a (`Part of #34766`): `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts` (pass `authoring` to `handleHttpRequest`) and a new open registry module beside it under `packages/runtime/src/domains/`, `packages/mcp/src/**` (instructions / skill-md entries the registry needs; tests), `packages/metadata-core/**` read only (`metaWriteCapabilityVerdict`), `docs/design/mcp-local-first-door.md` (one add-only dated note on the read-tool rename), their tests, root `.changeset/`. PR-b (`Fixes #34766`, claimed on this same lease when PR-a is in L1): a public draft-verdict method on `packages/metadata-protocol` (D2), `save_metadata_draft`, `delete_metadata_draft`, verdicts on `list_drafts`, the app-crm end-to-end.
Surface note (seat 3 rulings 23:11Z): D1 A: `manage_metadata` is the human's own grant, resolved from `principal.userId` through `metaWriteCapabilityVerdict`; the effective right is the intersection (token `metadata:write` AND the user's grant); fail closed on no `userId` or a throwing resolution; four pinned cells (token without scope, user without grant, both, API key hidden). D2 A: public verdict method so the reply carries `hint` (PR-b; Tier H if it reaches the spec contract). D3 A: the read tools are renamed `list_metadata_items` / `get_metadata_item` (collision with the cloud platform tool `list_metadata`, `packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-tool-names.ts:97`); `save_metadata_draft`, `delete_metadata_draft`, `list_drafts` keep the design names. D4: `save_metadata_draft` requires `package`; the refusal names which package to give.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent` (area o3-E), `model: TIER_DEFAULT (dispatch-gates --tier: no path-derived mandate for packages/runtime, packages/mcp)`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: no (no published accept set or spec export changes in PR-a)
Metadata-protocol: none
Responsibility: `n/a — not a defect card`
Thread-read: 6963514953
Premise: holds with four rulings (premise note /mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat3/o3-E/34766-premise-split.md at origin/main 4443014630): `mcp.ts:248-259` passes no `authoring`; the `McpAuthoringToolRegistry` seam (`packages/mcp/src/types.ts:97-102`, `mcp-server-runtime.ts:1720-1753`) and the `metadata:write` gate (`grantsAuthoringTools`, `mcp-http-tools.ts:2499`) exist; surface `'mcp'` is already in `MetadataAuthoringSurfaceSchema` (`protocol.zod.ts:563`); an OAuth agent with `metadata:write` alone holds no `systemPermissions` (`packages/core/src/security/assemble-execution-context.ts:358-364`), hence D1.
Serial constraints cleared: `released from the #34659 hold (6963486364); triage p1 6963514953; area o3-E's #34919 (service-analytics, mcp dataset text) and area o3-A's #34876 / #34877 (packages/mcp/src tests, describe_object text) are open neighbours: overlap-check at the first push and before every push`
Pre-claim lane: `domain:server` — the runtime MCP domain and the MCP door
Pre-claim deps: none open (#34659 hold released)
Prior rulings read: metadata:write,authoring,draft,McpAuthoringToolRegistry → #34659 D2 A / D3 A / E3 (6940528935), #34691 (6943107981), design `docs/design/mcp-local-first-door.md` (Design A), ADR-0033 read-side names; seat 3 rulings D1–D4 (23:11Z); repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack.

Lease `o3-E` (seat post #34584); child of epic #34659. L1-c, then the seat's fable L2 (D1 touches the authoring gate), then the landing tier per `check-governed-merges --pr`.
